claims.note: executed with father by Wang Mang

translationRepairs: Scholars swarm like thunderheads—layer on layer they crowd the eight circuits, every house fancying itself the line of Ji and Xie, every man a second Gao Yao; anyone in cap and ribbons plays at being yiyin day, and boys barely five feet tall scorn to mention Yan Ying or Guan Zhong. Catch favor and you ride the clouds; miss your footing and you lie in the gutter—minister at dawn, nobody at dusk.

Scholars swarm like thunderheads—layer on layer they crowd the eight circuits, every house fancying itself the line of Ji and Xie, every man a second Gao Yao; anyone in cap and ribbons plays at being Yi Yin, and boys barely five feet tall scorn to mention Yan Ying or Guan Zhong. Catch favor and you ride the clouds; miss your footing and you lie in the gutter—minister at dawn, nobody at dusk.

Focus unit 皆擬於阿衡 names Aheng/Yi Yin as the model; “yiyin day” is a corrupted rendering of that title/person, not a sexagenary day. The proposed idiomatic line restores Yi Yin and leaves the rest of the accurate human phrasing intact.

The gentlemen of the realm, thunder-moved and cloud-gathered, fish-scale layered in assault, all encamp in the eight regions; every household thinks itself Ji and Xie, every person thinks himself Gao Yao; those who wear head-wrap and trailing tassel in discourse all compare themselves to yiyin day; five-foot boys are ashamed to compare with Yan Ying and Yiwu day; those on the road enter blue clouds, those who lose the way are cast in ditches; at dawn grasping power they become ministers and chancellors, at dusk losing power they become common men;

The gentlemen of the realm, thunder-moved and cloud-gathered, fish-scale layered in assault, all encamp in the eight regions; every household thinks itself Ji and Xie, every person thinks himself Gao Yao; those who wear head-wrap and trailing tassel in discourse all compare themselves to Yi Yin; five-foot boys are ashamed to compare with Yan Ying and Yiwu; those on the road enter blue clouds, those who lose the way are cast in ditches; at dawn grasping power they become ministers and chancellors, at dusk losing power they become common men;

Focus unit has 阿衡 and 夷吾 as personal/title names with no day marker; the prior literal wrongly appends “day” to both. Replacing with Yi Yin and Yiwu corrects those names without changing the rest of the sentence.
On inquiry it emerged that Liu Xin’s son had once studied rare characters with Yang Xiong, of which Xiong knew nothing.
An inquiry found that Liu Xin's son Liu Fen had once studied rare characters with Yang Xiong, who knew nothing of the plot.
迺劉棻 names Liu Fen explicitly, while the preceding sentence identifies him as Liu Xin's son; the revision preserves both useful facts and renders 雄不知情 naturally.
After a while he asked the reason; it turned out Liu Xin’s son had once followed Xiong to study making strange graphs, and Xiong did not know the circumstances.
Later, inquiry was made into the reason; it turned out that Liu Fen, Liu Xin's son, had once studied the construction of rare characters under Xiong, who knew nothing of the affair.
The source names 劉棻, and the preceding sentence establishes his parentage; this literal revision restores the name without discarding the contextual identification.

Therefore those who set the policy think that affairs may rise without waning and things may flourish excessively without loss; hence in peace one does not recklessly venture into danger, in security one does not forget peril.

Therefore those who set the policy think that affairs do not rise high without being reduced and things do not flourish without loss; hence in peace one does not recklessly venture into danger, in security one does not forget peril.

Focus unit 事罔隆而不殺，物靡盛而不虧 means nothing rises high without being cut back and nothing flourishes without loss; the prior literal reversed both clauses into “without waning/without loss.” The proposed repair restores the double negation correctly.
